title: Shrimpers along the Texas Coast find healthcare on fishing docks
summary: DocSide Clinic is a free pop-up clinic that brings healthcare and social services to shrimpers once a month. The clinic operates in Galveston, Port Arthur and works with partners in...
content: DocSide Clinic is a free pop-up clinic that brings healthcare and social services to shrimpers once a month. The clinic operates in Galveston, Port Arthur and works with partners in Louisiana as well as Puerto Rico. Source

title: Texas Standard for Nov. 18, 2026: ‘Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother’ explores faith and family in Houston
summary: Filmmaker Bassam Tariq draws on the Houston of his own upbringing for “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother,” starring Mahershala Ali. Set amid the city’s mosques, markets and immigrant communities,...
content: Filmmaker Bassam Tariq draws on the Houston of his own upbringing for “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother,” starring Mahershala Ali. Set amid the city’s mosques, markets and immigrant communities, the film explores faith, family and conflict without offering easy answers. Source
